texto_fixo.regras: ONE single figure, framed as the pose says, seen in a 3/4 view turned to the RIGHT side of the image, the whole figure inside the image with margin. NO furniture, NO chair, NO table, NO desk, NO floor, NO background objects (a sitting pose sits on NOTHING — an invisible seat; the furniture is a separate layer); a small handheld object only if the pose needs it. No panels, on a flat solid chroma-key green background (#00FF00), no shadow on the background. ABSOLUTELY NO TEXT in the image: no letters, no words, no speech balloons, no thought bubbles, no sound-effect onomatopoeia lettering, no captions, no narration boxes, no signs or labels with writing, no watermark.
